source.text:
Location: Europe (remote)

Remote: Yes, remote only

Willing to relocate: No

Technologies: HTML/CSS, WordPress, mobile layout fixes, page speed, broken link checks, Gmail / Google Sheets / Apps Script automation, AI agent setups with a human approval step

Résumé/CV: https://deskstack-ai.surge.sh/ (clickable demos)

Email: via https://payhip.com/DeskStackStore (reply to your Payhip receipt) or DM @DeskStackBjarni on X

I'm Bjarni, a solo freelancer working as DeskStack. My main focus is home-service companies (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing), also clinics and real estate teams: making sure their website loads fast, works on phones and has no broken links so enquiries are not lost.

Small fixed-price jobs, all in writing, no calls:

- Website Rescue Audit, €49: speed, mobile layout and broken links on one public website, checked within 2-4 hours after I receive the website address. https://payhip.com/b/1PlIt

- AI Inbox Assistant, from €190: email enquiries only. It sorts them into four labels and prepares reply drafts. Drafts by default; you decide if sending is ever switched on. https://payhip.com/b/hMAJy

- AI Agent Office, done-for-you install, €190, delivered within 5 business days: a supervised setup with a human approval gate. Demo: https://deskstack-ai.surge.sh/agent-office/ Order: https://payhip.com/b/U4te8

All offers: https://payhip.com/DeskStackStore
